correctness.rationale: Every coloring lies in the diagonal or off-diagonal recurrence families, exhaustively counted by cyclic proper 3-color words and six even-case alternatives. Component counts per omitted color are r_q when positive and two when zero, or (2,1,1) in the complementary alternating case. Exactly three bichromatic cycles pass through a fixed cubic vertex, giving degrees F-3. Direct independent graph search for n=3..11 and cyclic-word checker n=3..12 reproduce all exact formulas. No finite extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: The original 2017 primary article singled out the ordinary prism family as an elementary-looking but structurally unresolved test case. This theorem proves an all-n local mobility invariant for every normalized optimal three-edge-coloring: regular at odd n, exactly two geometrically characterized exceptional states at even n, plus exact state and edge numbers. It provides a natural meaningful structural partial answer, not a tiny arbitrary finite instance.
